unit.why: A single anecdote about R. Hayyim of Sanz travelling in winter to the Rizhiner, refusing to rest on the way out of longing to reach him.

stories.start_quote: ידעתי מפי מגידי אמת שכאשר מרו
stories.end_quote: פני הקדוש באיזה רגעים אחדים במוקדם
stories.summary_en: R. Hayyim Halberstam of Sanz travels by wagon in winter to see the Rizhiner. He refuses his attendants' pleas to stop and warm himself. When they get the driver to halt for a night, he does not sleep or lie down, out of longing to see the tzaddik even a few moments sooner.
